pet_notes: Create the same mascot as the approved portrait as a compact full-body Papillon dog. Preserve the enormous fringed butterfly ears, symmetrical white forehead blaze, black facial mask, warm dark-brown eyes, pink tongue, fluffy white chest ruff, black-and-white coat, and the small red square paw-print patch attached to the screen-right cheek. Infer a petite natural dog body with a plumed tail. Keep the character friendly, expressive, readable at small pet size, and consistent across every pose.
